question: Three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in a certain way and one is different. Pick the odd one out.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d16e50abe1a866069dc7ff61c99f97f83c1c43a73bc7da4d0c011f370fc1dfe.png] 

The logic followed here is :-

 
• **According to English alphabetic series the difference between the position values of first letter and second letter is (2).**
 
• **According to English alphabetic series the difference between the position values of second letter and third letter is (2).**

So,

 
• Option - (1) : FDB

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b6b54f7af2d793b7aaa22646e8ba5934ef5125aef695d67184a5e6d4db1fd676.png] ​

 
• Option - (2) : ZXV

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/71cd478f5b35622cf8ae344c63e9bd705e8714a397d4f1736ec8276392b93f85.png] ​

 
• **Option - (3) : JIG**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5f98fab70107986bc4978f384ef583e4a447698ab2fe60e01bcfdd434bf59fcf.png] ​

 
• Option - (4) : LJH

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/44270a85fa39bec0f6e55cf8b15d64b38dcefc5a614388146d7b25b964311259.png] ​

Hence, the correct answer is "**JIG**".

42:Tc4
